## Outline

- **(20m) Exercise: `06_lgcp-selfexcite`.** Fit an LGCP with self-excitement to
  a short snippet of the call series, with the assistant doing the typing. The
  loop: state the model, let it draft, read the draft, correct the
  parameterisation, refit.
- **(15m) Exercise: `07_verify-the-assistant`.** Interrogate the fit *without*
  the assistant. Does the intensity integrate to roughly the observed count?
  Does the self-excitement kernel have a sensible timescale? Then ask the
  assistant to critique its own fit and see whether it finds what you found.

## Takeaway

The AI accelerates the work. You remain the scientist.
